review_items.rationale: Artifact c044230f88d8471f868b4bfe0f7d584b fixes the inspected driver and plan; execution 92f9eafb5eda45ac87090790bf0aed6c ran it without target changes. The applicable interface distinguishes implicit automatic exit from explicit caller-proposed exit. The code itself owns the zero-change proposal in appliedTo. Generic retry duties for externally proposed commands do not require an unrelated command to complete an already applied implicit transition. Initialization uses three actual Bootstrap instances; bootstrap configurations are persisted/applied before actual message-driven election. Configuration entry 5 is proposed through RawNode and returned in CommittedEntries before ApplyConfChange, not fabricated as committed. TransferLeader is called serially after that application but before Advance; Node.run also permits protocol work while Advance is outstanding, and no interface rule prohibits this overlap. Persistence precedes message publication, application indexes are contiguous, and the driver acknowledges every returned batch. MemoryStorage is appropriate for the explicitly crash-free execution. Only one actual TimeoutNow is lost; after the ten-tick timeout the driver drops nothing and fairly services all three nodes, both quorums and every queued response. Admission event 9 and transfer event 10 correlate to result 16 through case=transfer_overlap, operation=implicit-remove-3 and entry index 5. The result is not filtered by joint state, AutoLeave or recurrence. The independent antecedent recurrent=true and measured joint_active=true violate the stated implication. This is a closed-suffix argument rather than a deadline: three separately serialized snapshots at ticks 20/30/40 are byte-equal, with every RawNode field, nested storage contents, timers, progress/inflights and pending response included. All three nodes have term 2, commit=applied=applying=5, incoming voters {1,2}, outgoing {1,2,3} and live AutoLeave=true; leader remains 1, transfer is zero, queues and callbacks are drained. The repeated external ten-tick schedule has no fresh inputs and visits nodes/progress deterministically. Follower heartbeats reset electionElapsed each round; CheckQuorum succeeds with responsive quorums. Therefore no role reset or random timeout draw occurs inside the repeatable suffix; the captured randomized thresholds remain fixed. Reflection dereferences values into new JSON strings, so equality is not an alias-to-current-state comparison. Function code pointers describe fixed tick/step handlers and their receiver state is captured separately. Slice contents, offsets, full inflight buffers and pending slices are captured; capacities/allocation identity cannot create future application work on this read/heartbeat-only cycle. Omitted callStats are counters incremented only for diagnostics, mutex state is uncontended in this single-threaded driver, default logging only emits text, and default build tracing is no-op. None supplies an omitted continuation trigger. Actual auto-exit producers are appliedTo (application or snapshot acknowledgment), whereas timeout only clears leadTransferee; no pending entry/snapshot remains to create such an acknowledgment. A new proposal after the witness advances/applies and exits, which supports the trigger explanation without being the oracle. Config.Clone omits AutoLeave, but the fixed recurrence and result read the live tracker and thus do not mistake that export discrepancy for lost protocol state. Raw Go JSON Output chunks split the long state_cycle line; concatenating Output payloads reconstructs valid full state JSON, and controller parsing reports no errors. The complete overlap witness survives the independently unmatched control operation. Explained alternatives retained: The no-transfer control leaves joint at index 6, and the later ordinary proposal lets the overlap run leave at index 7. Thus this is not unconditional inability to exit, quorum unavailability or log replication failure. A successful leader change would append new work and can restore the automatic exit trigger. Public Status.Config.AutoLeave is false because Clone omits it; live state remains true and was used for the recurrence.
review_items.report_title: 领导权转移超时后，隐式联合配置退出缺少继续触发
review_items.report_answer: 真实三节点执行中，配置变更已提交并应用，领导权转移仅丢失一次消息后超时。随后两轮完整服务周期的协议状态重复，联合配置仍未退出；新增普通提案才恢复退出。此结果不依赖人为设置的完成期限。
limitations: Control result event 6 has no transfer admission and is not formally evaluated; monitor comparison coverage is partial, while overlap witness 16 is complete.
The finding concerns loss of automatic continuation under this stable idle workload after finite transfer failure; it does not assert a numeric exit deadline.
Crash recovery, async-storage variation, arbitrary membership layouts and downstream outages are not measured.
The Config.Clone omission remains an independent candidate surface, not an inferred live consensus mutation.
